_about: Tap meanings for な-adjectives by what follows: 'X|な' (before a noun: the adjective) and 'X|に' (the adverb, or 〜になる / 〜にする). The dictionary's first sense is often the noun (自由 freedom), which misleads in 自由にお取り下さい. Applied to every sentence's tap meanings by tools/na_glosses.py.
自由|に: free; (自由に) freely, as you like (自由にお取り下さい: help yourself)
健康|に: healthy; (健康に) healthily, for your health
危険|に: dangerous; (危険にさらす) expose to danger
むだ|に: wasteful; (むだに) uselessly, in vain (無駄)
ひま|な: free, not busy (暇な時: free time) (暇)
楽しみ|に: (楽しみにする) look forward to
反対|に: (反対に) on the contrary; the other way round
嫌い|な: disliked (嫌いな食べ物: food you dislike)
好き|な: liked; favourite (好きな色: favourite colour)
きれい|に: pretty, clean; (きれいに) neatly, cleanly, completely
元気|に: lively, healthy; (元気に) energetically, in good health
大切|に: precious; (大切にする) treasure, take good care of
大事|に: important; (大事にする) take good care of; (お大事に) get well soon
明らか|に: clear, obvious; (明らかに) clearly, obviously
全国的|に: nationwide; (全国的に) all over the country
自発的|に: voluntary; (自発的に) of one's own accord
無理|に: unreasonable; (無理に) by force, against one's will
当たり前|に: natural, usual; (当たり前に) as a matter of course
にぎやか|に: lively; (にぎやかに) in a lively way
ていねい|に: polite, careful; (ていねいに) politely, carefully (丁寧)
真っすぐ|に: straight; (真っすぐに) straight ahead, directly
